messages:
maya: quick sync — where are we on onboarding the new open LLMs for the catalog? need status on: licensing sign-off, perf profiles, and who's owning the rollout checklist. cc @sarah (legal) @alex

alex: I have a draft perf profile for the 7B and 13B variants. ran baseline across p50/p95 on g4dn and am attaching the head results in thread. p50 is good, p95 spikes on long context. working on KV cache tweak. :eyes:

pradeep: licensing: OSS license scan done for model A and model B; model C flagged for non-commercial clause. asked upstream for clarification, waiting on reply. added ticket ML-342 to track. @sarah (legal) can you confirm next steps if upstream replies 'noncommercial'?

sarah (legal): thanks — if upstream confirms non-commercial, we can't list model C in hosted catalog. Options: (1) include as "private-only" in dedicated/private deployments after customer agreement, (2) ask community for permissive weights, or (3) exclude. Will follow up on ML-342; keep me tagged when they reply.

alex: putting perf notes here:
```
model: open-llm-13b
seq_len: 1024
hw: g4dn.xlarge
p50_latency: 120ms
p95_latency: 420ms
mem_peak: 8.3GB
notes: p95 driven by attention kernels on long seqs; recommend int8-quant + KV-cache on host.
```
planning to push profile to catalog draft by EOD. ping @taylor for any console display constraints.

taylor: UI note — catalog expects: display_name, model_card_url, perf_profile_tag, license_tag. if perf_profile_tag missing we render "profile pending" which affects launch checklist. We should gate GA on having at least p50 + mem_peak for each model.

maya: great. owning rollout checklist: I'll coordinate cross-team. owners: maya (launch PM), alex (perf profiles), pradeep (license tracking), taylor (console + UX), sarah (legal sign-off). Dependencies: eng-sre for infra limits, privacy for model card PII checks. any blockers?

pradeep: blocker = upstream reply for model C. timeline unknown. if it takes >2w we should mark model C as "catalog candidate" and not GA. created slack reminder for follow-up in 3 business days.

alex: blocker = need infra test runs on dedicated pool for quant profiles — eng-sre asked for a lightweight smoke script. posting snippet:
```
# smoke.sh
python ./bench.py --model open-llm-13b --batch 4 --seq 512 --quant int8
```
can someone from eng-sre run this on dedicated? @eng-sre if available pls.

maya: I will add these action items to the tracking doc and create a canary plan. Plan: GA without model C, soft launch to beta customers next week if legal + perf profiles complete.

deploy-bot: scheduled: catalog-draft -> /staging at 2025-10-12T14:00Z by taylor (:rocket:)

alex: acked. I'll finalize profiles and upload to the catalog draft after smoke runs.

maya: thanks all. I'll post the checklist link in ML-342 and ping again after upstream reply. :thumbsup:
